title: Measure a coding job's instruction load and refuse a route that cannot hold it
goal: Before each step NERV counts the instruction load and task prompt and refuses a route whose context cannot hold it with headroom
acceptance: A failing-first test: a coding job on a route with a context window below instructionTokens + taskTokens + 16,384 (or below 32,768) is refused at admission with the measured numbers in the reason, and nothing runs
The load counts AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, the procedure files the step triggers and the task prompt, with the route token counter or characters / 4 when it has none
A route that holds the load is admitted unchanged; coding-job-contract.md section 4 names the code
privacy: Neutral fixtures and a scratch repository only; no personal data, no paid route.
escalation: A change of gate class, a paid route or a material effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: a counter over the instruction files, an admission check in the coding job and its tests. Not a measurement.
